events.title: Russian conquest
hints: A winter invasion crossed the frozen sea in March 1809.
A peace treaty at Fredrikshamn moved the islands east.
events.summary: During the Finnish War of 1808–09 Russian troops crossed the ice to Aland and forced Sweden to cede the islands. The Treaty of Fredrikshamn in September 1809 transferred them to Russia along with Finland.

events.title: Anglo-French attack on Bomarsund
hints: A Russian fortress under construction was bombarded by two navies in the Baltic.
Afterwards the demilitarisation of the islands was negotiated.
events.summary: During the Crimean War an Anglo-French fleet and troops captured and destroyed the Russian fortress of Bomarsund in August 1854. The 1856 Aland Convention then demilitarised the islands.

events.title: German intervention in the Finnish Civil War
hints: After a Swedish expedition in February 1918, a second foreign force landed in the spring.
Troops of an empire at war occupied the archipelago until the end of the year.
events.summary: In 1918, during the Finnish Civil War, Swedish troops landed on the Aland Islands in February and German forces arrived in March, occupying the archipelago until the end of the year. The islands' status was later settled by the League of Nations in 1921.
